limitations.detail: Public APIs require no auth; private endpoints use apiKey+apiSecret+passphrase per official SDK but signature algorithm not documented in corpus
All responses wrapped in {code,msg,data}; candle rows are arrays [ts,open,high,low,close,vol,volCcy] with millisecond timestamps
Candle/ticker/depth paths sourced from official blofin.readme.io OpenAPI index; provided corpus only documented /uapi/v1/market/symbol/all
Order placement endpoints not documented in provided corpus â market data only
Docs list futures (perpetual contract) quotation APIs only; margin trading/order API details absent from corpus
min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
min_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
max_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 100000.0
max_risk_coef not documented â using conservative default 3.0
price_band_pct not documented â using conservative default 5.0
qty_step not documented â using conservative default 8
fee_pct not documented â using conservative default 0.2
interest_per_4h_pct not documented â using conservative default 0.05
Rate limits not stated in corpus â min_gap_sec kept at conservative default 1.0
